## kb_to_source

- Every normative claim traced to source (same product-wide pass as task 0). Additions: none.
- Omissions / rewrites: **D2**.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none. Opening world state written as fact: none.

### Difference list
- **D2 — omission (assembly operator), wrong_shipment_refund_calculation_9826e17e, "Assembly", single bullet.** Source: "The covered share and the repeat share are multiplied together and applied once to the wrong-shipment refund basis, giving the refunded wrong-shipment charge." KB states the covered-share multiplication but carries the repeat share only through "every proportion entering it is taken of that fee-plus-surcharge figure itself, never of another proportion's result" — no operator, and a literal prohibition on the product. Whole-domain: at a 50% covered share with a 75% repeat share the source gives 37.5% of the basis and the reductions reading 25%. This task's world (100% cover) yields the same value under every reading, so the scored 16.91 is unaffected.
- (D1 of task 0 — the same omission in late_refund_calculation_28604bde — lies outside this task's policy scope; recorded in task 0.)

### Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts)
- N1 (as task 0): `item_return_required` / `unreturned_item_charge_basis` keep live-looking meanings ("must be sent back", "net price of the item kept") in return_retention_and_chargeback_terms although R.3 is superseded; the KB renders the parameters faithfully and marks R.3 retired. Relevant to this task's subject: a reader sees "Charged when a required item is not sent back | the net price of the item kept" beside the keep-charge rule; the hub and recovery_policy ("now governed by the current wrong-item keep charge rule") decide it.
- N2 (as task 0): computation documents carry the source assembly ("Where rates apply …", "Any keep label saving"); wrong_shipment_refund_calculation's "of itself" mirrors the source baseline's own "by default".
- N4: the undelivered-refund tool contract reads "on an approved claim whose merchandise is refunded or reshipped" while the rule owes nothing on a reshipped claim; the KB reproduces both faithfully (entitlement decides).
